correctness.rationale: All-length proof: quadratic Walsh polar-rank identity gives n/4-to-3n/8 Hamming gap and classifies minimum supports; the least essential bit bounds cyclic runs; eight adjacent block-pair indicators yield initial rank 7; explicit degree-two words generate exactly the new quotient directions at successive dyadic pair thresholds. The complete numerical pair-weight rank profile was independently enumerated for m=3,4,5 (67,709 nonzero vectors), and inductive generators checked for m=3..8. Finite tests corroborate rather than replace proof. Endpoints and cyclic wrap checked.

value.rationale: The exact filtration determines every connected-component size for a classical code family under the recently introduced pair-protection framework. It is all-length, gives sharp thresholds and explicit generators, and reveals a genuinely quadratic staircase of dimensions rather than a textbook Hamming spectrum or arbitrary finite computation. It motivates concrete admissible-function class limits and a coordinate-order distinction.
